Player

Structures Tab [NEW]

- Auto Deconstruct – Remove structures based on conditions
- Repair Range – Maximum distance for auto-repair
- Repair Cooldown – Delay between repair attempts
- Deconstruct Threshold – HP percentage to trigger deconstruction
- Schematics – Blueprint visualization and placement

Misc

Recent Changes

Important Notes on Safety

Speed & Teleport Bypass
While other scripts claim to have "bypassed" speed/teleport restrictions, our testing shows they still trigger anti-cheat flags. We will not implement instant teleports or higher speeds – your account safety is our priority. Some features found in other scripts are intentionally excluded for this reason.

Recommendation: Do your own research before using scripts from other sources. Many haven't been updated for recent anti-cheat changes and can result in delayed bans.

REBIRTH
